result.detail: Docs set no GitHub review, verification or listing step before other users or orgs can authorize an OAuth App or install a public GitHub App. They set no install or user cap for unreviewed apps. The only limit is per user: ten tokens per user/application/scope combination, and ten tokens created per hour. Public GitHub Apps can be installed by other accounts. Marketplace is one optional way to share an app. The pages I read didn't cover org-level OAuth app restrictions, which are an approval by the customer's org, not by GitHub.
result.quote: You can enable other users to authorize your OAuth app.
